revision_summary: No critical fabricated quotes were found — the one flagged item (bill_quote at 03:13) is a minor timestamp precision issue (words span 03:12-03:15, not a fabrication) and does not on its own require rerun. However, revisions are needed on three fronts: (1) Schema misuse — cherry_pick_moments[1] cites protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number for a house-buying-scam suspicion that isn't a clean match to that protocol's data-privacy framing; relabel as a novel scam-anxiety variant or map to the TBD scam_encounter_reference item instead. cherry_pick_moments[5] self-cites 'prior_contact_probe_miss' as its own schema_reference, which isn't a real schema section — remap to coaching_philosophy.empathy_on_vulnerability_disclosure or explicitly mark as novel/ungrounded. (2) Invented classification — 'softener_overuse' at 02:26 is not schema terminology; either ground it in an existing category or flag it explicitly as a new pattern for schema consideration, and reconsider the energy_match citation, which is a poor fit for verbal disfluency rather than tempo/pace mismatch. (3) Missed moment — the verify.title_co_owners question at 02:49 was posed to the caller (the son) about his own title status, when the actual homeowner is his mother Rita via a transfer-on-death deed; script_coverage marks this simply as 'asked' without flagging that the question targeted the wrong person, which could propagate an inaccurate co-owner record into the handoff brief. Add this as a flagged qualification-accuracy issue. Additionally, soften the causal claim in cherry_pick_moments[0] that the missing intro directly caused the scam suspicion (the customer's own disclosed history of predatory calls about his mother's house is at least as strong a driver), and reconsider the 00:44 state_change label ('suspicious → mildly disengaged') as speculative given the customer's immediately following cooperative tone. The outcome dispute (booked→callback reclassification) is well-supported and should be retained as-is.
